name: FormBackend Free
free_limit: Hosted form submission backend: 1 form and 50 submissions per month, with up to 10 spam submissions per month, customizable thank-you page, data export and auto-delete scheduling up to 30 days. Free hosted form-builder offering is separately advertised and must not be confused with the standard endpoint-based Free plan.
watch_out: Standard Free plan has no file uploads, webhooks, auto-responder or paid notification integrations. Monthly submission limits apply; provider says it warns before the limit and may require upgrading. The separate 'Free hosted' form-builder offering advertises different limits; do not combine allowances. Commercial-use permission for the Free plan is not explicitly confirmed on the pricing page; human review required.
